inspect_briefing_example.description: Open the actual approved website in a local browser. Read its visible text, expand full sessions, or open citations and writing passages. No summary is generated.

page.description: Relative website page, such as index.html or a linked document page.

target.description: Target returned in actions; empty string reads the whole page.

action.description: read, session, or citation. Read passage buttons use citation.

offset.description: Character offset; start at 0 and follow next_offset with the same page, target and action.

content.description: Exact saved text, without a summary.

next_offset.description: Next character offset, or -1 when finished.

actions.description: JSON list of visible links, images, and exact targets for controls.

presentation.description: Path to the actual stylesheet under the example root.

calculate_activity_times.description: Calculate activity times and save time-plan.json and time-estimates.json in this run. Each successful call replaces both files; supply the complete plan each time. Calculate only the activities supplied in the plan. Choose records for the activities. Check whether messages are automated prompts before counting them as work. Record selection and exclusion reasons in the calculation plan. Gaps and playback do not measure continuous attention. Leave activities without enough evidence unestimated.

plan.description: JSON with activities and not_estimated (short reasons for activities without an estimate). Each activity has id, label, reason, mode, and optional excluded: [{record_ids, reason}]. A field reference is {record_id, field}, where field is a dotted path in the prepared record, such as time.local, time.end, or attributes.msPlayed. Use points with points: [field references], gap_minutes, and optional compare_gaps. This counts first-to-last time in each group; a single point adds zero. Use intervals with intervals: [{start: field reference, end: field reference}]. Record connections between different endpoint records in the activity reason. Intervals are clipped to the day and overlaps count once. Use durations with durations: [field references] and unit: milliseconds, seconds, or minutes. Each selected duration counts once. Supply saved fields, not invented times or calculated totals.

estimates.description: Calculated durations and the records and assumptions used to calculate them.

files.description: Supporting file references to return with the draft.
